title: Weissenburg
summary: Raleigh names Weissenburg in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Weissenburg, also printed Weishenburg, cited on the names Chabol and Libanon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter VII, §. III, subsection VII, sig. 222b–223a
